- `tokio/src/time/clock.rs:208` — `advance` calls `crate::task::yield_now().await`. This is the test-util version of the function.
- `tokio/src/runtime/scheduler/multi_thread/trace.rs:38` and `:58` — `TraceStatus::start_trace_request` and `TraceStatus::end_trace_request`.
- `tokio/src/runtime/scheduler/multi_thread_alt/trace.rs:38` and `:58` — the same two `TraceStatus` methods. This file is identical to the `multi_thread` one except for one import.
